findings.locator: Selected remedy, printed pages 2–4; history, printed pages 7–8; investigation/exposure findings, printed pages 10–13. Soil-results PDF page 12 visually checked.
findings.finding: Former Iroquois Doors millwork and lumber property, later commercial occupants, PAHs/metals in buried fill, selected excavation of approximately 250 tons, confirmation sampling, cover and site management for restricted residential reuse. Barium maximum in the summarized soil dataset is 6,290 mg/kg against a 400 mg/kg restricted-residential objective. Possible slag fragments noted at one investigation location.
findings.limit: Selected tonnage is not a completed removal quantity. Possible slag does not identify a producer, transport route, isotope, or radioactive waste. Soil maxima are sample-specific, not averages or exposure measurements. Groundwater total and dissolved results must remain distinct; some dissolved magnesium/manganese results also exceed comparison standards. DEC's vapor conclusion was no further on-site action and no indicated off-site building concern.

findings.finding: Phase II borings and accessible excavations examined historic use, drains, sumps, staining, a suspected heating-oil tank, and impacted urban fill. Earlier analytical results support investigation rather than attribution to one waste supplier.
findings.limit: 2023 maxima differ from later investigation-summary maxima because these are different sample sets; do not interpret their numerical difference as a time trend.

findings.finding: Separate approximately 5,000-gallon vaulted aboveground fuel-oil tank, proposed removal, residual-waste management, underlying-soil sampling and documentation requirements.
findings.limit: Plan is not a removal certificate, disposal receipt, tank closure report, or final engineering report. No visible tank-release evidence was reported in the described inspection; do not automatically assign all fill contamination to the tank.

findings.finding: April/May 2025 investigation, targeted soil/fill areas, selected cleanup approach, community air monitoring, dust suppression, access and tracking controls during intrusive work.
findings.limit: Forward-looking tank-removal language and a November 2025 planning reference do not settle actual removal timing. Obtain field logs and final documentation rather than declaring the tank work completed.

findings.locator: PDF pages 1–3 visually reviewed: clerk recording sheet and easement pages 1–2
findings.finding: Erie County Clerk recording date April 7, 2026, book 11459 page 2541; approximately 0.70-acre controlled property; permitted restricted residential/commercial/industrial use subject to continuing site management and controls.
findings.limit: Recorded easement is a land-control milestone, not proof that every remedial task is complete. Decision acreage is about 0.72 and amended controlled acreage differs; use recorded survey for any future polygon.

findings.finding: Directory contains the decision, remedial plans, amended agreement, and recorded easement. No final engineering report or Certificate of Completion is listed in the reviewed directory.
findings.limit: Directory absence does not establish that work never occurred or that no other agency file contains a completion record.

findings.candidate: Hartwell Street Landfill / Atlas Steel identity lead

findings.finding: DEC GIS names Hartwell Street Landfill / Atlas Steel at 1963 Elmwood Avenue, Buffalo, class N. Archive includes 1986 and 1992 investigations and a 2016 spill report.
findings.limit: Older measured findings and the current landfill-initiative footprint still require document-level reconciliation. Record retained as identity research, not published as a new pin.

findings.locator: PDF page 2, final Site Background paragraph, visually checked; PDF page 1 for August NECRA screening and referral
findings.finding: DEC states that information about the small area of elevated readings in the 2020 redevelopment survey was not conveyed to DEC until August 2026. That information, together with recent NECRA findings, prompted reevaluation. Separate August 2026 agency screening led to EPA referral.
findings.limit: Does not establish the exact receipt day, transmitting person, prior recipients, reason for the interval, deliberate concealment, radionuclide, or exposure to neighbors. Request the original survey/field records, transmission correspondence, and DEC intake records. Do not claim these records have already been obtained or that a records request has been sent.
